note: Shared corpus locking the two hand-mirrored alternates twins across runtimes: QRID_swallowSum / CheckCharacter::swallowSum and QRID_alternatesOf / CheckCharacter::alternatesOf. Both are load-bearing — swallowSum is the structural proof that no member length can be built by adding others (a mis-scan reading back as one verified ID), and alternatesOf is the normalizer every consumer runs on. Neither had a direct cross-runtime test: swallowSum was reachable only through configError text and the JS twins were not exported (round 3, L-3). Expectations are hand-written from the definitions, not recorded from a run. Read by tests/alternates_dom_js.cjs and tests/annotation_php.php.
